newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: OAU summit begins in Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: OAU summit begins in Zimbabwe.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity began a three-day summit in Harare on Monday, with the crisis in Sierra Leone expected to dominate a meeting called to focus on economic issues.

Those attending included nearly 30 heads of state or government, U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan and James Jonah, Sierra Leone's U.N. ambassador who is representing President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah. Kabbah was ousted in a coup staged by junior military officers a week ago.
Laurent Kabila of the Democratic People's Republic of Congo is also at the summit where political developments in his Great Lakes Region are expected to feature prominently.
